dsa-v1-d06-recursive-list-sum.note: Target: O(n) time and O(n) extra space from waiting recursive frames, where n is the number of list nodes under constant-cost field reads and Number addition. Empty input is constant work; the finite call counter does not measure memory.

dsa-v1-d06-bounded-factorial.note: Target: O(n) time in the numeric input n under the variable-n, unit-cost multiplication model. The actual accepted Number inputs remain 0 through 20; a loop and the allowed recursion have different auxiliary stack costs.

dsa-v1-d06-iterative-countdown.note: Target: O(n) time, where n is the starting numeric bound and the result holds n + 1 fixed-size Numbers. Under the usual amortized append model the output uses O(n) space while an iterative implementation needs constant auxiliary stack; zero is constant work.

dsa-v1-d07-linear-search.note: Target: O(n) time in the worst case and O(1) extra space, where n is the input length and indexed reads/strict equality count as unit operations. An early match may finish sooner; empty input is constant work.

dsa-v1-d07-first-occurrence.note: Target: O(log n) time and O(1) extra space, where n is the array length under constant-cost numeric comparison and indexing. Empty input is constant work. The read-budget fixtures remain bounded examples, not a complexity proof for arbitrary source.
